title: Randomized-base GT transfer, lazy-descent STNFS core (recover-Q 9332a74d with our v7/v8 levers) with measured wide-prime kernels, a pre-registered fresh judged pool, excess 1.05 at purge target 0.0001 and complete-orbit unit duplicates: 123.171939321487363

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). It maps T to z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b (exactly the uniform nonidentity-base, independent-target distribution), converts both into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. The core is that of recover-Q 9332a74d with our recover-Q v7 and v8 levers: excess 1.05, theta=2326/8000 sub-region sized on an independent 656,000-draw pool B and judged once on a fresh 656,000-draw pool D (retained relations >= 2^63.6016, 0.0798 bits above 1.05 U, 4.5 pool SE), 99.9% ECM, X2=2^64, slacks (295, 226), band strip, f-first early abort, certified norm bounds shared by aligned 2 x 2 x 4 boxes of rows, primes in [2^63, 2^64) on the measured wide path (1.01 x the slice12 0bbca0b2 record-path price), work estimated on pools B, C and D with allowance 1.0047: collection <= 2^119.555197429 units; purge to excess 0.0001 U, Markowitz merge to weight 300, N <= 2^58.9650, eight owners, Block Wiedemann (28, 5) with five-vector Krylov passes at 13.21 instructions per vector-entry: linear algebra <= 2^117.337606666, generator <= 2^107.842105567; 62-node lazy descent with sub-bin yields (24 node / 10 boot sub-cells, capped at 4x / 1.5x the sextile yield), the re-searched plan and boot (215, 328, 16, 4), UDUP 0.65 supported by complete unit orbits against the charged yield, lazy cofactorisation and lazy boot (at most 18 relations), and the descent relation input 2^63.583, one relative pool SE below pool D's retained-count estimate: expected two-log work <= 2^112.3879, meter 2^113.104, Markov abort <= 0.6087409, boot failure <= 9.363e-06 per log, node counter 2^27.3 (abort <= 2^-11.66), repeats <= 2^-10.70, 2/r charged; upper-rounded core ledger rows sum to at most 2^119.85001122655 <= 2^119.8500112266 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, sampling, verification and output, is at most 10 x 2^119.8500112266 + 2^80/2000 < 2^123.171939321487363 G1 reference units (C=2,000). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit. {}: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, integration probes, lazy bound vs a simulation, core ledger and success, G1 conversion (80-digit) and base-randomisation bijections. {"descent": true} also re-evaluates the descent recurrence, node counter and success. evidence16.py (local, about 4 minutes natively, not a hosted experiment) reruns every certificate and check.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py, purge target 0.0001) at relation excess 1.05 (default; optional 'excess') and the shipped means to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.87) and U/N. Optional. Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
